theses.thesis: T1: Azure growth stays above 30% as the commercial backlog converts into revenue.
theses.signpost: Azure growth at or above 30% in the Q2 FY2027 results (January 2027). Invalidation: Azure growth below 25% in any FY2027 quarter, or backlog growth falling well below revenue growth.

theses.thesis: T2: Free cash flow rebuilds as capex growth moderates.
theses.signpost: FY2027 capex growth below 30% and positive free cash flow growth in the FY2027 10-K (July 2027). Invalidation: free cash flow falls again in FY2027, or capex growth stays above 50%.

theses.thesis: T3: The current price needs more growth than history or consensus supports, so returns will lag unless growth beats expectations.
theses.signpost: FY2027 revenue of at least $396.0 billion, the consensus figure, in the FY2027 10-K (July 2027). Invalidation: FY2027 revenue growth of 22% or more, or a share price fall that lifts the implied return above the WACC.

theses.thesis: T4: EPS estimates keep rising, which supports the earnings base behind the valuation.
theses.signpost: EPS beat and further upward revisions at the Q2 FY2027 results (January 2027). Invalidation: a quarterly EPS miss, or cuts outnumbering raises in the 30-day revision count.
